title: opensAt is not an RFC 3339 timestamp
description: opensAt carries prose instead of an RFC 3339 date-time, violating format: date-time. Stands in for every date-time-formatted field (postedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, deadlines[].date, provenance.submittedAt, provenance.verifiedAt): an implementation that ignores formats accepts this document and is not conformant.
